podcast.title: Recovery from On-Stage Pyro Incident (1997)
podcast.body: In 1997, as the bass player for Furnace Face, Slow Tom was involved in an on-stage pyro incident. Despite the scary moment, he fully recovered from the experience. "There was a scary moment in 1997 when bass player Slow Tom ended up at the wrong end of some on-stage pyro, but he recovered."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Current Country Band and Freelance Composer
podcast.body: Currently, Slow Tom fronts a country band that performs occasionally, and this group also features Furnace Face drummer Dave Dudley. He additionally works as a freelance composer, creating music for film and television projects. "These days, Tom has a country band that plays the occasional gig, and that group also features Furnace Face drummer Dave Dudley. Tom also has at least three solo albums to his credit, and he's a freelance composer for film and TV these days."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
